description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Paradox Haze and Tamiyo's Journal trigger.
Resolve the Paradox Haze trigger, getting an additional upkeep step after this one.
Resolve the Tamiyo's Journal trigger, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure token.
At the beginning of your second upkeep, Tamiyo's Journal triggers, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure token.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five artifacts, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
